blind.B1: Yes, with a caveat: ILT is diet restriction plus supervised exercise (S4.3.3.p1), so the exercise factor is not separable from weight loss. Exercise-carrying samples: ILT arm post vs pre (muscle 8 participants = 16 samples, fat 10 = 20 samples). SC is the control arm (muscle 6 = 12, fat 7 = 14); 62 samples total (FIG3, FIG4).
blind.B2: Muscle RNA-seq after vs before within each arm: SC n=6, ILT n=8 (FIG3, S2.6.p1). Adipose selected genes after vs before: SC n=7, ILT n=10 (FIG4). ILT vs SC by ANCOVA for selected genes only.
blind.B3: Yes: every participant has before and after biopsies, and muscle plus fat from the same person. Key: subject (3-digit id in the title) within tissue; title minus tissue also links muscle and fat of the same sample. Packet A shows subject appears 4x (2 per tissue).
blind.B4: The paper does not say whether the edgeR fit was paired or unpaired, or per group. S4.4.p1 says 'P-value and false discovery rate (FDR) for each gene were calculated by using the edgeR R Bioconductor package' and mentions repeated-measures ANOVA only for selected genes. Fig 3A reports each arm's before vs after separately.
blind.B5: S4.4.p1: 'Genes with log2 |fold change| > 0.3 and FDR < 0.05 were considered differentially expressed genes (DEGs).' Strict, FDR. Counts (S2.6.p1): muscle SC 65 DEGs, ILT 1,540 DEGs.

checks.evidence: Analyzed; caveat that ILT combines diet and exercise is recorded in paper_reconstruction and study caveats (S1.p3, S4.3.3.p1).
Muscle ILT 16 samples (8 pairs), SC 12 (6 pairs); fat ILT 20, SC 14; matches FIG3 n=6/8 and FIG4 n=7/10. No exclusions.
post vs pre (treatment=post, control=pre) in every contrast; A=Before, B=After cross-checked against GEO sample type.

Formula ~ subject + time within each tissue/arm subset; design_check shows subject as categorical columns (subject_3, subject_4 ...), full rank, so numeric ids were not fitted as a slope (answers flag numeric_blocking_ids).

Paper is silent on pairing (B4). Paired fit gives muscle SC 0 DEGs vs paper 65, and ILT 1382 vs 1540; raw p<0.05 in SC gives 922 genes. Only the paired fit is reported; the paper's edgeR may have been an unpaired or joint fit.
checks.fix: Add an unpaired (no subject block) limma fit of muscle SC and ILT post vs pre as a labelled sensitivity next to the paired primary, and report both counts against 65 / 1540.

checks.evidence: Exercise aliased with energy restriction/17% weight loss in ILT, recorded in caveats; no batch/sex column; sex handled via subject block.
Deposited file is moderated log2 CPM (2^x sums ~1e6/column); routed to limma on log scale, declared deviation from edgeR on counts. p histogram for ILT fine (frac_p_gt_0.9 0.049, p_lt_0.05 0.311).
Applied padj<0.05 and |log2FC|>0.3 strict equals S4.4.p1; audit rule recorded; no other rule in packet B table reproduces 1540 or 65.
Pairs compare the same contrasts (muscle ILT and SC after vs before); HANDBACK reports 0 vs 65 and 1382 vs 1540 without claiming agreement. Estimand wording is cautious.

human_items: Which fit to treat as primary when the paper is silent on pairing (joint vs pairwise, paired vs unpaired) and counts differ (SC 0 vs 65).
summary: 该案例的分组、方向、配对（subject作为分类变量做区块）、阈值（FDR<0.05且|log2FC|>0.3）均与论文一致，混杂（运动与饮食/减重）已记录。主要问题是论文未说明edgeR是否配对，而配对拟合在SC组得到0个DEG（论文65个），ILT为1382（论文1540），只报告了一种拟合。建议补充不配对拟合作为敏感性分析并并列报告。
